name: Agriculture Law
description: Agriculture Code: Farming, ranching, livestock, crops, seeds, pests, diseases, aquaculture, agricultural markets, branding, fences, extensions.

name: Alcohol & Beverage
description: Alcoholic Beverage Code: Liquor, beer, wine, licensing, manufacturing, distribution, sale, enforcement, TABC regulations.

name: Business & Commerce
description: Business & Commerce Code: UCC, statute of frauds, deceptive trade practices (DTPA), competition, identity theft, contests, warranties, business rights.

name: Business Organizations
description: Business Organizations Code: Corporations, LLCs, partnerships, non-profits, professional associations, mergers, dissolution, governance.

name: Texas Constitution
description: Texas Constitution: Bill of Rights, legislature, executive, judicial branches, suffrage, education, taxation, counties, railroads, impeachment, general provisions.

name: Civil Practice & Remedies
description: Civil Practice and Remedies Code: Lawsuits, liability, immunity, damages, limitations, venue, evidence, arbitration, medical malpractice, appeals.

name: Criminal Procedure
description: Code of Criminal Procedure: Arrests, bail, warrants, trials, sentencing, grand jury, discovery, habeas corpus, statutes of limitations for crimes.

name: Vernon's Civil Statutes
description: Vernon's Civil Statutes: Miscellaneous uncodified civil laws (legacy statutes not yet moved to other codes).

name: Education Law
description: Education Code: Public schools, school districts, teachers, students, higher education, funding, discipline, curriculums, school boards.

name: Election Law
description: Election Code: Voter registration, ballots, polling places, candidates, campaigns, political parties, election contests, recount procedures.

name: Estates
description: Estates Code: Wills, probate, descent and distribution, guardianship, powers of attorney, heirs, estate administration.

name: Family Law
description: Family Code: Marriage, divorce, child custody (SAPCR), child support, adoption, protective orders, juvenile justice, parental rights.

name: Government
description: Government Code: State agencies, open meetings, public information (PIA), public officers, state purchasing, courts, judges, notary public.

name: Human Resources
description: Human Resources Code: Social services, elderly protection, rights of marginalized, rehabilitation commissions, human services agencies.

name: Health & Safety
description: Health and Safety Code: Public health, hospitals, sanitation, vital statistics, mental health, controlled substances, safety regulations, animals.

name: Insurance (supplemental)
description: Insurance Code (supplemental): Additional insurance regulations not yet fully codified, industrial insurance, specialty coverage.

name: Insurance
description: Insurance Code: Insurance policies, insurers, rates, agents, regulation, consumer protection, health, life, property, casualty insurance.

name: Labor Law
description: Labor Code: Employment, workers' compensation, wages, paydays, discrimination (state level), labor unions, unemployment.

name: Local Government
description: Local Government Code: Municipalities (cities), counties, zoning, ordinances, civil service, platting, annexation, public services.

name: Natural Resources
description: Natural Resources Code: Oil and gas, mines, timber, public land management, beaches, dunes, wetlands, land office.

name: Occupations
description: Occupations Code: Licensing and regulation of professions (doctors, lawyers, plumbers, electricians, etc.), health professions, trades.

name: Penal Code
description: Penal Code: Criminal offenses (theft, assault, homicide, fraud, etc.), penalties, defenses, criminal culpability, punishments.

name: Property Law
description: Property Code: Real estate, conveyances, deeds, liens, landlord-tenant, HOAs, trusts, escheat, mechanics liens, homesteads.

name: Parks & Wildlife
description: Parks and Wildlife Code: State parks, hunting, fishing, boating, wildlife conservation, licenses, water safety.

name: Special Districts / Social Services
description: Special Districts: Social services districts, community supervision, child welfare services, developmental disability services.

name: Transportation
description: Transportation Code: Roads, highways, vehicles, driver's licenses, traffic laws (rules of the road), vehicle registration, aviation.

name: Tax Law
description: Tax Code: Property tax, sales tax, franchise tax, hotel tax, appraisal districts, exemptions, tax collection.

name: Utilities
description: Utilities Code: Electricity, water, gas, telecommunications, deregulation, PUC regulations, rates, services.

name: Water Code
description: Water Code: Water rights, water districts, flood control, drainage, irrigation, water quality, conservation.

name: Auxiliary Water Laws
description: Auxiliary Water Laws: Uncodified water laws, special water districts, river authorities (supplemental to Water Code).
